checks.result: The task state, exact generated Wave/capability views, and patch hygiene validate. No UI/reference path, schema DDL, migration, dependency lock, or public Core API changed.

evidence: AggregateRepository, UnitOfWork, and UnitOfWorkFactory are typed ports. Returned factory, unit-of-work, and repository objects retain only opaque 64-hex tokens; database paths, CanonicalConnection, sqlite3, SQLAlchemy rows, and ORM entities do not cross the business boundary.
An AST boundary regression denies SQLite/SQLAlchemy imports and ad hoc SQL in every production Core module outside storage, repositories, and the migration adapter.

BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes the optimistic read/write decision. Revision, kind extension, provenance fact, and pending outbox record are committed together; leaving without commit or failing at a late outbox/FK constraint rolls every inserted row back.

Focused tests distinguish bounded RO-CORE-REPOSITORY-NOT-FOUND and RO-CORE-REPOSITORY-CONFLICT outcomes and reject stale revisions, changed aggregate kind/creation identity, and regressed modification time.

The deterministic fixed-ID/time helpers exercise record, document, workflow, evidence, ontology, and decision adapters, two committed revisions after reopen, no-commit rollback, late failure rollback, conflict, not-found, and frozen projection behavior.

The affected schema, migration, project lifecycle, Core API, quality, architecture, ADR, packaging-contract, real frozen-package, build-identity, task, and generated-view checks pass at the exact implementation commit.

Storage architecture and portable-contract documentation now define the typed port, explicit commit, atomic outbox/provenance, detached projection, and bounded failure behavior without changing the v2 DDL/profile fingerprint.

The quality and frozen-sidecar inventories contain the new repository implementation and direct regression tests. The implementation changes no migration, dependency, UI/reference, rights, security, or business-feature behavior outside this approved repository seam.
